blocks.orig: Simba Farm Lodge on the slopes of the mighty Kilimanjaro guarantees a great stay on a real farm. From here it is possible to make a day hike on Kilimanjaro. But it is also a great place to relax, for example you can enjoy the view of the African plains from the swimming pool. With its comfortable rooms and fantastic meals, Simba Farm Lodge is the perfect lodge to absorb African culture!
blocks.html: On the slopes of the mighty Kilimanjaro, Simba Farm Lodge promises a lovely stay on a working farm. You can set off from here on a day hike on Kilimanjaro. It is also a good place to unwind; you can, for instance, look out over the African plains from the swimming pool. Thanks to its comfortable rooms and excellent meals, Simba Farm Lodge is an ideal lodge for soaking up African culture!
